items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: He really had started out the club with Kelly Martin... But by the time I got there Howard was gone, but we knew about each other.

ctx.x: From the Paradise Theatre, yeah. And they had a great, great band in there, a really good band, like some of the top players in the band... He really had started out the club with Kelly Martin, a fine drummer, and he had guys like Howard McGhee and a lot of great players who were in that band. But by the time I got there Howard was gone, but we knew about each other. Big Nick told me one night, he says, "Look, man," he says...
